summary: Describes a Uniform Resource Name (URN) namespace for the Internet2 Middleware Architecture Committee for Education (MACE). The namespace is for naming persistent resources defined by MACE, its working groups and other designated subordinates. It is a registration document for the namespace, not a new protocol.

eli5.summary: A school gives every student an ID number that never changes, even if the student moves. This document sets up a naming system like that, so one education group can give its things permanent names.
